'''Deschon''', officially the '''United Republic of Deschon''', is a country in [[South Acrola]]. It is bordered by [[Yoprioq]] to the northwest; [[Viussi]] to the north; [[Pelines]] to the northeast; the [[Fire coast]] and [[Rijan bu]] to the east; [[Inania]] to the south; and [[Jathua]] to the west. According to a 2024 estimate, Deschon has a population of around [[List of countries and dependencies by population|30.6 million]], making it the most populous country located entirely south of the equator in [[Acrola]].

Many important [[Fossils|hominid fossils]] have been found in Deschon. In the Stone and Bronze Age, [[prehistoric migrations]] into Deschon included Southern [[Vialqooa speakers]] similar to modern-day [[Taldi people]], who moved south from present-day [[Viussi]].  These movements occurred around the same time as the settlement of the [[Lake Erhau]] area. In the mid 17th century, the mainland came under [[Ashain|Ashani]] rule as [[Ahanini South Acrola]]. This was followed by [[Emara|Emaran]] rule after the [[Red War]], when it was governed as the [[South Acrolan colony]], with the [[Yoprioq]] remaining an integrated colonial jurisdiction. Following their gaining respective independence in 1711, the two entities became separate countries.

Deschon's population comprises over [[130 ethnic, linguistic, and religious groups]]. _____ is the largest religion in Deschon, with ____ and ____ minorities. Over [[100+ languages]] are spoken in Deschon, making it the fourth most linguistically diverse country. The country does not have a de jure official language, although the national language is [[Taldi language|Taldi]]. [[Lastnu language|Lastnu]] is used in foreign trade, in diplomacy, in higher courts, and as a medium of instruction in secondary and higher education. Ashani is widely spoken in the capital [[Obelinti]], reflecting its history as a trading center dominated by [[Ashain]].

Deschon is mountainous in the south and densely forested elsewhere, where [[Mount Ellnjare]], the highest mountain in [[Acrola]] and the highest single free-standing mountain above sea level in the world, is located. The [[Qanai Bay Conservation Area]] is a large marine protected area. The [[Kalkal Falls]], located on the central River at the [[Viussi]]-[[Pelines]] border, are the second-highest uninterrupted waterfalls in [[Acrola]]. Deschon is one of the most visited tourist destinations for [[wikipedia:Safari|safaris]].
